### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>sigstore/fulcio (github.com/sigstore/fulcio)</summary>

### [`v1.10.1`](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/releases/tag/v1.10.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/compare/v1.10.0...v1.10.1)

#### What's Changed

This release adds experimental support for signing certificates with ML-DSA, per RFC 9881. Note that the Sigstore client tooling does not yet support ML-DSA signed certificates. To learn more about Sigstore's support for post-quantum cryptography, see <https://blog.sigstore.dev/pqc-sigstore/>.

- Return clear error and log when CA signing key is unavailable in [#​2527](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/pull/2527)
- feat: add support for ML-DSA in [#​2522](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/pull/2522)
- feat: support ML-DSA keys in certificate maker in [#​2531](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/pull/2531)
- fix: when handling the trusted k8s issuer always allow add the authorization header in [#​2530](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/pull/2530)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/sigstore/fulcio/compare/v1.10.0...v1.10.1>

### [`v1.10.0`](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/releases/tag/v1.10.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/compare/v1.9.1...v1.10.0)

#### What's Changed

v1.10.0 is published from an updated release pipeline. Attestations are now generated using GitHub's [Artifact Attestations](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/concepts/security/artifact-attestations) ([viewable here](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/attestations), and can be verified with the GitHub CLI or Cosign, with the signing identity `https://github.com/sigstore/fulcio/.github/workflows/release.yml` for binaries and `https://github.com/sigstore/fulcio/.github/workflows/build_container.yml` for containers. Signatures on the release can be verified by downloading the [artifact verification key](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/root-signing/blob/main/targets/artifact.pub) from Sigstore's TUF repository.

We have also stopped publishing releases for the following architectures: s390x, ppc64le, and armv7, and arm. Releases are now for Linux and Darwin amd64 and arm64.

See the README for instructions on verifying the binaries and containers.

- Migrate release and container build pipeline to GitHub Actions in [#​2510](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/pull/2510)
- Add flag to override default blocked IPs in [#​2509](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/pull/2509)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/sigstore/fulcio/compare/v1.9.1...v1.10.0>

### [`v1.9.1`](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#v191)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/compare/v1.9.0...v1.9.1)

This release builds with Go 1.27.3 to pick up a recent security fix.

#### Fixes

- Apply the blocked CIDR list to loopback addresses too ([#​2485](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/issues/2485))

### [`v1.9.0`](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#v190)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/compare/v1.8.8...v1.9.0)

This release bumps the minimum Go version to 1.27, in order to support ML-DSA in a future release.
Prebuilt containers now use the latest Distroless image based on Debian 13.

#### Features

- Specify the environment the identity provider is supported ([#​2410](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/issues/2410))
- Serve TLS on HTTP/duplex and make TLS policy configurable ([#​2418](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/issues/2418))

#### Fixes / Refactors

- Format large whole-number claims without scientific notation ([#​2406](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/issues/2406))
- Replace archived go-grpc-prometheus with go-grpc-middleware provider ([#​2428](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/fulcio/issues/2428))

</details>
